create_texturesvertex: create a TexturesVertex object with per-vertex RGB features for a mesh batch
create_texturesatlas: create a TexturesAtlas object with per-face square texture maps for soft rasterization
create_texturesuv: create a TexturesUV object with texture maps and UV coordinates for each mesh
sample_textures_from_fragments: sample texture values from rasterization fragments using barycentric coordinates and pix_to_face
join_texture_batch: join a list of TexturesUV objects into a single batched texture object
